It’s finally here!! Last week, we put the first episode of The Human Element on the big screen at a premiere in NYC. After years of making videos for the internet, getting to experience one with a live audience for the first time was incredible. Even more meaningful to share that moment with the incredible team who brought this show to life.

Can’t wait for you all to finally see it this week on Newpress.com and on YouTube Nov 7.

Thanks to everyone who has supported this series. I cannot wait to share it with you!
